messages:
maya: FYI pushed slimpatch firmware (bmc-2.1.9-slim) to rack-7 OOB pool at 02:12 UTC. After the job, 4 nodes show the SOL console hung and SOL stream returns repeated "Connection reset by peer". Not seeing usual boot logs.

device-manager-bot: Job 4823 finished for fleet/rack-7 (success: 98%, failed: 4%)

chris: which node ids? can you paste the hostnames and chassis IDs so I can check IPMI sessions? :eyes:

maya: affected: r7-n021, r7-n034, r7-n038, r7-n042. chassis IDs 7:21..7:24. All in eu-west-1.

ana: any secure-boot/UEFI toggles in that slimpatch? last time a flag flip caused a BIOS handoff.

maya: patch was intended to be BMC-only (microcontroller flash + watchdog fixes). No intentional BIOS change but the script had a post-update hook that pokes SEL and toggles power state. logs show POST started then nothing.

leo: try dumping current BMC state and SOL config before power-cycling. Commands I usually run:
```
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P "***" sol info
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P "***" sel elist
ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P "***" chassis power status
```
If SOL is stuck, run `ipmitool sol deactivate` then re-activate. Also check `racadm getversion` on iDRAC nodes.

maya: ran sol info on r7-n021: SOL enabled, but trying to `ipmitool sol activate` yields `Connection reset by peer`. SEL shows repeated entries: "Host startup timeout" x3.

oliver: do not mass power-cycle without a rollback plan. Last time a partial power cycle left 2 nodes in firmware update mode and they needed serial SPI recovery.

chris: agreed. Plan: isolate the 4 nodes (remove from scheduler), create maintenance ticket, attempt soft SOL reset + IPMI LAN reset, then a controlled power cycle if SOL doesn't recover after 10m. If power cycle fails, move to SPI recovery runbook.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-214 opened by maya: "oob console hang post firmware slimpatch" (sev: low -> elevated if >6 hosts)

maya: executing soft steps now. documented commands I'm running: 
```
# deactivate any stale SOL sessions
ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P "***" sol deactivate
# clear IPMI lan channel then reload
ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P "***" lan set 1 ipsrc static
ipmitool -H $BMC -U admin -P "***" mc reset cold
```

leo: if `mc reset cold` takes BMC offline for >2m and doesn't come back, don't power-cycle the host. File a hardware recovery ticket with vendor and get SPI kit in parallel.

maya: update: r7-n021 BMC came back after `mc reset cold`, SOL reattached and boot logs continued. r7-n034 and r7-n042 still hang on SOL. r7-n038 entered "firmware-recovery" state, BMC shows build 0xFFFF.

chris: mark r7-n038 as needing SPI recovery. I'll start drain + reprovision for the other two if they don't recover within the hour. Can ops approve a 30m maintenance window?

ana: confirm that secure boot flags were not toggled on those hosts (I pulled NV vars via ipmi fru and they show SecureBoot=setupmode for r7-n038 only). Looks like r7-n038 flipped into setup mode during the post hook.

oliver: that explains the POST hang on that host. SetupMode forces a firmware validation path that some firmwares can't handle in this state. SPI recover or vendor tool needed.

maya: opening vendor support case and ordering SPI kit to eu-west-1 colo. I'll also revert the job and blacklist the post-update hook in the job definition.

chris: good. After rollback, we should run a smaller canary (1 host) with verbose SEL collection and keep the post-hook disabled. Also tag the patch as DO NOT AUTO-ROLL for the other regions until we confirm.

maya: noted. I'll follow up with the rollback PR and incident updates. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
